select-option-layer.purpose: Coordinate grouped options, empty states, unavailable options, stale data, permission reasons, keyboard movement, and responsive popover-to-sheet behavior for Select-based choice flows.
entryConditions: Options are grouped, remote, stale, unavailable, searchable, permissioned, or too long for a simple base Select demo.
Mobile requires a sheet or full-screen selector instead of a small popover.
Unavailable options need visible reasons instead of disappearing.
decisionTree: Use base Select for short, stable option lists.
Use Select Option Layer when grouping, freshness, disabled reasons, or mobile sheet behavior becomes part of the decision.
Escalate to Multi Select or Search when users must choose many values or query remote results.
failureModes: Options appear without stable labels or values.
Loading, empty, stale, error, or permission states are visual only.
Focus does not return to the trigger after selection or dismissal.
successMetrics: Users understand unavailable options and recovery paths.
Keyboard and screen reader users can identify active, selected, grouped, and disabled options.

slots.name: field
slots.purpose: Owns selected value, trigger, labelled field semantics, and value cascade.

slots.name: choices
slots.purpose: Groups related choices without moving option behavior into docs or templates.

slots.name: optionActions
slots.purpose: Provides confirm, clear, retry, or recovery actions when option selection has consequence.

slots.name: validation
slots.purpose: Explains required, stale, permission-blocked, or invalid option state.

slots.name: fallback
slots.purpose: Owns empty, permission-blocked, or unavailable-option recovery without inventing a parallel overlay.

agentInstructions: Keep Select as the base component and move grouped option sequencing into this pattern.
Document option source, stale/loading/error states, disabled reasons, focus return, and mobile sheet behavior.
Ask before adding search, multi-select, product process, or measurement behavior beyond option selection.
rejectIf: Grouped option behavior is hidden inside the base Select component.
Unavailable options lack a visible reason.
Mobile keeps a cramped desktop popover for long or grouped options.
Raw colors, spacing, radius, shadows, or motion bypass Design System tokens.
